summary: Ran a fresh isolated Google Chrome context at 1280x900 against https://autopilot.local/zamowienie/ without submitting any form. The registration opener changes aria-expanded false to true, reveals the role=dialog/aria-modal=true element, and focuses the username input. Escape hides the dialog, restores aria-expanded=false and returns focus to the opener. The consent checkbox is keyboard reachable and toggles with Space, and no page errors occurred. The modal nevertheless lacks a visible close control, does not contain focus, and places the consent checkbox outside the pointer-reachable viewport.
issues: CHK-INT-001 | priority: high | property: visible dialog dismissal | expected: the source X is an operable close control in addition to Escape | actual: the only button/[role=button] inside the open dialog is the registration submit button | fix: add the source-backed accessible close button and wire it to the existing close behavior.

CHK-INT-002 | priority: high | property: modal keyboard focus containment | expected: Shift+Tab from the first field wraps to the last focusable control inside the aria-modal dialog | actual: Shift+Tab moves focus outside the dialog to the background registration opener | fix: implement focus trapping for the open modal and restore focus on every close path.

CHK-INT-003 | priority: high | property: pointer reachability at 1280x900 | expected: consent and primary action are reachable within the open modal by pointer or modal scrolling | actual: consent checkbox bounding box begins at y 1085.89 below the 900 px viewport and Playwright pointer click times out after attempted scrolling; keyboard traversal can still reach and toggle it | fix: fit the dialog within the viewport or provide an internal scroll region while keeping controls visible and reachable.
